entrants.method: Ordinary least squares straight-line fit over the recent history, extrapolated at most 21 days past the last observation. The classic linear-model baseline.

backtest.note: 22 releases every entrant answered, 2025-05-31 to 2026-07-23. Each model is scored only on releases after its own training cutoff; this table is the intersection, so every row is measured on the same points. Rows ending -zeroshot saw the question and no series history.
